title: The Den Music
eyebrow: BadCode Shorts · The Den · music round 1
heading: Pick the music for The Den
intro: Jack asked for pitch-show background music. Four writers each took a different approach, and Suno made two takes of each (8 in all). Each opens on suno.com to listen. Pick one in the row (or none) and leave a note: what to keep, what to change. Not heard by Claude.

sections.lede: The cut is 42.8 s, so a take needs to run at least that long. The pick goes under the voices, turned down under speech.

groups.title: One bed under the whole short

opts.label: Synth pulse, take 1 (1:01): low analog bass pulse, clock-tick hi-hat, cold pad
Low strings, take 1 (0:59): clipped cellos and basses, timpani, a brass swell
Piano and clock, take 1 (0:59): one low piano note, a ticking clock, lots of silence
Industrial hits, take 1: metal percussion and taiko over a warehouse drone
